requirements.summary: Remove the login/logout button from the Header component while preserving admin link functionality and authentication infrastructure
acceptanceCriteria: The login/logout button is no longer visible in the header
The header layout adjusts appropriately without the button
Internet Identity authentication hooks remain available for other components if needed

file_operations.description: Remove the login/logout button (the button element with login/logout functionality) from the Header component. Keep the logo, admin link for authenticated admins, and 'Order Now' CTA button. Adjust the header layout and spacing to accommodate the removal of the button while maintaining the fixed header structure with backdrop blur and scroll effects. The authorization component is required to maintain the admin link functionality for authenticated administrators.
